Also, do you have any insights on how farmers can adapt to these changes? Recommender: Absolutely! There are some great documentaries and books that delve into the impacts of climate change on agriculture. For documentaries, I'd recommend "The True Cost" which touches on the broader impact of fashion and agriculture, but it also covers the environmental and social issues related to food production. Another one is "Seeds of Time," which focuses more specifically on the role of seeds and their conservation in the face of climate change. For a more in-depth look, you might want to check out "Dirt! The Movie," which explores the importance of soil health and its role in sustainable agriculture. For books, "Drawdown: The Most Comprehensive Plan Ever Proposed to Reverse Global Warming" by Paul Hawken is an excellent resource. It includes detailed strategies and solutions, including those specific to agriculture. Another great book is "Climate Change and Agriculture: Mitigation and Adaptation" edited by John Reganold and Tad Pfeiffer, which provides a comprehensive overview of both mitigation and adaptation strategies for farmers.
